prompt: As of August 1, 2024, which country were holders of the FIFA World Cup the last time the UEFA Champions League was won by a club from London?
answer: Spain. Chelsea, the only London club to win the UEFA Champions League, won it in 2012; Spain were the reigning FIFA World Cup holders after winning the 2010 tournament.
